_comment: Kimi — the product-discovery conversation on the homepage. Flags and every visitor-facing string live here so marketing can change the words and the team can switch a piece off without touching next/kimi-flow.js. {name}, {first}, {email}, {product}, {need}, {capability} are filled at render time. The on-page persona stays 'Stagwell AI'; Kimi is the internal name of the conversation engine and the primary model behind it.

copy.about: Stagwell AI is a custom portfolio of agentic solutions built for businesses of any size. It combines technology with deep marketing expertise to help businesses make better decisions, execute faster and drive stronger performance. On this page, the assistant asks a few questions about what you are trying to solve and recommends the Stagwell AI product that fits, then connects you with the right team.
